report:
In the medial compartment, there is small radial tear at the body of the medial meniscus. The articular cartilage appears normal. 
  
 The lateral compartment, the lateral meniscus is not torn. The articular cartilage appears normal. 
  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is diffuse low grade and high grade chondrosis (less than and more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) along medial and lateral trochleas, medial and lateral patellar facets. There is  subchondral edema. Osteophytes are present. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior cruciate ligament is intact. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is no tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. There is partial tear of the intraarticular portion, popliteus tendon. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
  
 Some amount of left knee effusion with synovitis is present. The surrounding musculature is normal.  Patellofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of the left knee by evidence of chondrosis, and osteophytes. 
  Small radial tear at the body of the medial meniscus.  
  Partial tear of the intraarticular portion, popliteus tendon.  
  Some amount of left knee effusion with synovitis: probable for inflammatory or infectious arthritis. Please further work up.

Das vordokumentierte Knochenmarksödem im lateralen Kompartiment regredient, ansonsten unauffällige Signalgebung der übrigen ossären Strukturen in den vorliegenden Sequenzen. Flächige Chondropathie im medialen Kompartiment ohne fokalen Knorpelschaden, die fokale T2-Signalanhebung in der Voruntersuchung möglicherweise Knorpelödem entsprechend. Retropatellar medial betonte oberflächliche Chondropathie. Dislozierter Lappenriss des Innenmeniskus aus der Pars intermedia und hinterer mit nach dorsal disloziertem Fragment, komplexe Rissbildung in der Restsubstanz. Kleiner Substanzdefekt im Außenmeniskusvorderhorn, der vordokumentierte DD winzige Lappenriss nicht mehr sicher abgrenzbar.  V. a. basisnahen inkompletten longitudinalen Riss im Pars intermedia und Hinterhorn des Außenmeniskus (5/20 sowie 3/102) mit deutlich Einblutungen in Lokalisation der popliteomeniskalen Faszikel (6/22) DD bei Ruptur. VKB-Ruptur femoralseitig. Hinteres Kreuzband mit intakter Signalgebung. Zunehmend narbige Veränderung bei Z. n. Partialläsion des MCL in den tiefen Anteilen, LCL mit intakter Signalgebung. Konstanter mäßiger Gelenkerguss. Flüssigkeitsgefüllte Baker-Zyste mit einer CC-Ausdehnung von 4,6 cm. Unauffällige Signalgebung der Quadrizeps- sowie Patellarsehne. Die miterfassten Weichteilanteile den vorliegenden Sequenzen mit unauffälliger Signalgebung.

> Obliteration of posteiror horn of medial meniscus, in favor of tear.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
> No strong MR evidence of tear of lateral meniscus.
> The contour of ACL is in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury.
> The contour of PCL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Wearing of articular cartilage of left knee, more severe at medial compartment, and subchondral edema and spur formation, reflecting osteoarthritis
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> A lobulated cystic lesion in medial popliteal fossa between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles, in favor of Baker's cyst.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.

Impression:

2. Tear of medial meniscus.
3. Grade 1 injury of ACL.
4. Synovitis of left knee and suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae.
5. Baker's cyst.
